items.title: Zelensky warns Russia may expand missile threats from Belarus against western Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukraine's State Border Guard Service spokesperson Andrii Demchenko has separately reported that equipment based in Belarus helps relay or amplify signals for Russian Shahed and Geran drones heading toward western Ukraine and Poland's border region.

items.title: Romanian fighter jets shoot down two drones over Black Sea
items.teaser: Two F-16 fighter jets of the Romanian Air Force shot down two drones on Saturday evening that had illegally entered Romanian airspace over the Black Sea.

items.title: Russlands Bedrohung für Deutschland: Wie groß ist sie?
items.teaser: Experten sehen Deutschland bisher militärisch und mental wenig vorbereitet auf russische Provokationen - und warnen vor der Vorstellung, ein Ende der Ukraine-Unterstützung würde Deutschland sicherer machen.

items.title: Pope speaks with Ukrainian woman before returning to Vatican from hospital
items.teaser: Pope Leo XIV left the Agostino Gemelli University Hospital in Rome on Saturday afternoon, October 17, and returned to the Vatican.

items.title: Air Raid Alert app now tracks movement of Russian drones and missiles
items.teaser: The “Air Raid Alert” app now features a map showing the estimated flight paths of enemy drones and missiles.

items.title: Rumänien schießt zwei Drohnen über dem Schwarzen Meer ab
items.teaser: Nach mehreren Angriffen auf Schiffe in der Region hat die rumänische Armee nach eigenen Angaben über dem Schwarzen Meer zwei Drohnen abgeschossen.

items.title: Ukraine hits Russian drone manufacturing plant in Rostov Oblast
items.teaser: Among the drones it produces are the Sarych, which uses video and thermal imaging equipment for surveillance, and the Klin, a loitering munition designed to strike targets, according to Ukraine's military intelligence agency.

items.title: Erneuter Vorfall - Kampfjets schießen Drohnen über Rumänien ab
items.teaser: In Rumänien hat die Armee zwei Drohnen über dem Schwarzen Meer abgeschossen.

items.title: Russian strike on energy facility in Chernihiv region leaves nearly 19,000 customers without power
items.teaser: In the Chernihiv region, nearly 19,000 customers were left without power due to Russian shelling of an energy facility.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Russian forces launch another attack on energy facility in Ternopil region
items.teaser: An energy facility in the Ternopil region was struck again by a Russian attack.

items.title: Selenskyj kritisiert Trumps Aussetzung von Russland-Sanktionen
items.teaser: US-Präsident Trump setzt geplante Russland-Sanktionen aus - während Angriffe auf die Infrastruktur laut dem ukrainischen Staatschef Selenskyj zunehmen. Er warnt, Trumps Entscheidung werde Moskau nur weiter bestärken.

items.title: Russian attack causes power outages in Chernihiv district
items.teaser: A Russian attack has damaged an energy facility in Chernihiv Oblast, leaving approximately 19,000 consumers in the Chernihiv district without electricity.

items.title: Ukraine, EU set up joint task force to fast-track anti-corruption reforms that gate membership
items.teaser: Brussels and Kyiv will meet to grind through the anti-corruption reforms.

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell September 2026
18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen für den 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle sind ab sofort möglich.

items.title: Russian shelling in Dnipropetrovsk region injures three people
items.teaser: On October 17, Russian troops attacked the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 30 times, resulting in three people being wounded.

items.title: Russians attack energy facility in Ternopil Oblast again, causing power outages
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched another attack on an energy infrastructure facility in Ternopil Oblast, leaving some consumers in the Kremenets district without electricity.

items.title: G7 pledges 260 million euros to repair Chornobyl’s shield after Russia pierced it. Full repair will require 500 million euros by 2030, before corrosion sets in
items.teaser: Russian drone damaged the shield in 2025.

items.title: Russians attack critical infrastructure facility in Dnipro
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a critical infrastructure facility in the city of Dnipro on the evening of 17 October. Three people were injured in the Nikopol district over the course of the day.

items.title: Russian troops executed Ukrainian POWs in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, military says
items.teaser: The Russian soldiers are believed to belong to the 38th Separate Motorized Rifle Brigade, which is operating in the area. Kravchuk alleged that orders of this nature within the brigade are issued at the initiative of its commander, Colonel Valery Kazak.

items.title: Russian strikes on Kherson region leave one killed, 40 injured, including children
items.teaser: One person was killed and 40 others, including three children, were injured in Russian attacks on the Kherson region on October 17.

items.title: Ukraine cannot be forced to surrender, says commander whose brigade destroyed 57,000 Russian targets, as US pressure and Russian missiles test its will
items.teaser: Yurii Fedorenko of the Achilles brigade says the US turn toward Moscow may push Europe to arm Ukraine more.

items.title: Luhansk occupation authorities report large-scale power outages
items.teaser: Leonid Pasichnyk, the Russian-appointed head of the occupation authorities in Luhansk Oblast, has reported emergency power outages in Luhansk and 23 municipalities.

items.title: Rechtsruck - auch bei Israels linken Parteien?
items.teaser: Israels politische Landschaft ist über die Jahre nach rechts gerückt. Der Terroranschlag der Hamas vor gut drei Jahren hat diese Entwicklung verstärkt. Wie wirkt sich das auf linke Parteien aus? Von Jan-Christoph Kitzler.

items.title: Magyar says he has no objection to Ukrainian grain transit through Hungary
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar said he saw no obstacles to the transit of Ukrainian grain through his country, responding to an earlier request from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Moldovan president: drones do not ask what language you speak
items.teaser: During the National Forum of Ethnic Minorities, Moldovan President Maia Sandu has recalled the incidents of drones crashing in the country, urging citizens to unite and support EU accession.

items.title: How one invented claim becomes a chatbot’s confident answer in cognitive warfare: Ukraine’s drone chief maps Russia’s AI attack
items.teaser: Russia floods AI chatbots with millions of fake articles so they repeat Kremlin narratives as fact

items.title: Burnt-out wreck: Ukraine destroys Smerch rocket artillery system that terrorised Kherson and Mykolaiv oblasts – video
items.teaser: Lasar's Group, a special forces detachment of the National Guard of Ukraine, has destroyed a Russian BM-30 Smerch launcher and its transporter-loader vehicle in Kherson Oblast.

items.title: Russian forces aim to capture Orikhiv by end of October, Ukrainian military says
items.teaser: Russian commanders have ordered their troops to capture Orikhiv, Preobrazhenka and Tavriiske in the Zaporizhzhia region by the end of October. However, Russian forces have been unable to establish a foothold in Orikhiv, and their reports claiming to have cleared the city of Ukrainian defenders are false.

items.title: Aktualisierung der Anhänge der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung
items.teaser: Mit der Delegierten Verordnung vom 14.09.2026 hat die EU-Kommission die Aktualisierung des Anhang I der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung) auf den Weg gebracht.

items.title: 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Hinweis zum Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen sind ab 16. September 2026 möglich.

items.title: One killed and 37 injured in Russian attacks on Kherson in a single day
items.teaser: Russian forces launched airstrikes, artillery bombardments and drone attacks on Kherson Oblast on 17 October, leaving one person dead and 40 others injured, including 37 in the city of Kherson.

items.title: How big is Russia's threat against Germany?
items.teaser: Experts believe that, so far, Germany has been ill-prepared — both militarily and mentally — for Russian provocations. They also warn against the idea that ending support for Ukraine would make Germany safer.

items.title: Russian forces execute captured Ukrainian soldiers in Huliaipole sector
items.teaser: Law enforcement authorities have launched a pre-trial investigation into the execution of captured Ukrainian soldiers by Russian troops in the Zaporizhzhia region.

items.title: Erinnerung: Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO bis 11. September 2026
items.teaser: Vor einigen Wochen haben wir bereits per Newsletter über den Start der Umfragen zur Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung informiert. Da der Start der Umfragen ausgerechnet in die Ferienzeit fiel, möchten wir Sie hiermit erneut an die Umfragen erinnern.

items.title: Förderkompass 2026
items.teaser: Schnell zur passenden Förderung – erstmals ausschließlich digital verfügbar.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell Juli 2026
Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO
items.teaser: Wie in den vergangenen Monaten bereits angekündigt, hat die EU-Kommission den in Art. 26 Abs. 4 der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-VO) vorgesehenen Prozess zur Evaluation gestartet.

items.title: Zelensky: U.S. working to arrange possible meeting with Putin
items.teaser: The possibility of a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin remains under discussion.

items.title: Hungarian PM says he does not oppose transit of Ukrainian grain through Hungary
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar has stated that he sees no obstacles to the transit of Ukrainian grain through Hungary following a request from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

items.title: He was found under rubble by colleagues: Ukrainian emergency worker killed in Russian strike on Donetsk Oblast
items.teaser: Anatolii Hopka, a 41-year-old rescuer with the State Emergency Service of Ukraine, has been killed in a Russian airstrike on a residential building in Sloviansk.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhstal steel plant with ballistic missiles, causing damage
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the Zaporizhstal steel plant with ballistic missiles in the morning of October 17, damaging production facilities.

items.title: Nach Wappen-Sabotage - Löwen-Boss kritisiert Bayern wegen Anzeige
items.teaser: Gernot Mang, Präsident des TSV 1860 München, kritisiert bei BILD den FC Bayern.

items.title: Kromberg & Schubert plant in Lutsk halts operations following Russian strikes
items.teaser: The Kromberg & Schubert plant in Lutsk, which manufactures onboard electrical cable systems for cars, has suspended operations following Russian strikes on the facility.

items.title: Putin wants to deploy ballistic missiles in Belarus to attack western Ukraine, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said signal repeaters are operating in Belarus to help Russian drones reach western Ukraine, but Vladimir Putin wants to go further and deploy ballistic weapons in Belarus.

items.title: Vorankündigung des 18. Informationstags Exportkontrolle
items.teaser: Der Informationstag Exportkontrolle (ITE) wird am 10. Dezember 2026 in Frankfurt am Main stattfinden.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag in Berlin eröffnet
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. Unter dem Leitthema „Exportkontrolle in der Balance?“ diskutieren heute und morgen Vertreterinnen und Vertreter aus Politik, Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und internationalen Partnerorganisationen aktuelle Entwicklungen der Exportkontrolle.

Ukraine's General Staff confirms strike on Russian drone plant in Rostov Oblast – photo
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff has confirmed a strike on the Roboavia plant in Russia's Rostov Oblast, which manufactures UAVs for the Russian military.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukrainian and U.S. negotiating teams may meet next week
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said the Ukrainian and U.S. negotiating teams may meet next week.

items.title: Zelenskyy: neither US nor Russia has confirmed possible meeting with Putin in Miami
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says a trilateral meeting between the leaders of Ukraine, the US and Russia has been proposed for the G20 summit in Miami in December, but is not yet confirmed.

items.title: Russia may seek to get back frozen assets through Ukraine's partners, Zelensky says
items.teaser: "Today, this is fully under Europe's control. That means (Russian frozen assets) are safe for now," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Die Anmeldung zum Exportkontrolltag ist ab sofort möglich.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine needs more Patriot missiles from Europe now as new interceptor plans take shape
items.teaser: Ukraine currently needs a package of PAC-2 and PAC-3 missiles from Europe and some other countries, after which the FREYJA antiballistic program will come into operation and contracts with Germany to purchase the relevant interceptors will take effect.

items.title: Europeans are working on Starlink alternative and will succeed, Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that European countries are developing an alternative to Starlink after seeing how the US can restrict its operations.

items.title: Ukraine loses ability to use Starlink to shoot down jet-powered Shaheds – Zelensky
items.teaser: Starlink service in Ukraine is being limited to a speed of 161 km/h, making it impossible to use the system on interceptors targeting jet-powered Shaheds.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Russia wants to deploy ballistic missile systems in Belarus to attack Ukraine's west
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Russia intends to deploy ballistic missile systems in Belarus to attack the western part of Ukraine.

items.title: Over half of Russian jet-powered drones downed by Ukraine's aircraft, Zelensky says
items.teaser: Ukraine has secured contracts and assurances from partners on additional supplies of F-16 ammunition, Zelensky noted, adding that the current deliveries were at a "satisfactory level."

items.title: Commanders from Azov, Marines, and 93rd tell Ukraine’s defense minister what front needs. He wants their methods scaled to other units
items.teaser: The goal, he says, is to keep soldiers alive.
